title: PCSX5 normalized characterization trace v1
description: Evidence format, not architecture authority. Records observed legacy behavior, not hardware correctness. Event order is deterministic fixture order. Scalar values are lowercase fixed-width u64 hex; addresses are region-relative references. Never serialize timestamps, process addresses, OS thread IDs, proprietary inputs or secrets. Fixture producers must distinguish scalar values from pointers before serialization.

events.description: sequence must equal its zero-based array index; enforced by the executable validator.
